_doc: Reviewed same-food, same-state matches used by scripts/fill-nutrient-gaps.mjs to BORROW missing nutrient values. Key: the usda-foods.json fdcId. Value: an ordered list of sources (earlier wins per field), each { source: 'USDA-SR' | 'USDA-FOUNDATION' | 'FR-CIQUAL' | 'JP-MEXT' | 'DK-FRIDA' | 'UK-COFID' | 'AU-AFCD' | 'CH-SWISS', code: the source's food id (FDC fdcId, Ciqual alim_code, MEXT food number, Frida FoodID, CoFID food code, AFCD public food key, Swiss FCDB ID), name: the source's food name, match: 'exact' }. Only 'exact' matches (same food, same variety where it matters, same raw/cooked/dried state) are accepted. A { source: null, note } entry records a reviewed food with no exact match in any table. Candidates come from `node scripts/fill-nutrient-gaps.mjs --suggest`; every entry here was checked by hand.
